status: PROPOSAL (W2 PCB-SB1): board-side contract of the hatch board HATCH; not generated by mechanical/build.py and not checked by the mechanical collision model
why: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json has no HATCH entry (mechanical/params/boards.json:323 lists HATCH under small_boards with only the envelope 'layout hatch_parts'), and the HATCH-BOARD joint has no stack in mechanical/generated/fastener-stacks.json. pcb/board_gen.py and pcb/check_boards.py read the contract file named in pcb/boards/HATCH.json, so this file stands in until the mechanical lineage adopts the entry below into mechanical/params/boards.json (then the spec points at mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json; equal values keep the board inputs unchanged).
frame: board mm, origin = enclosure (108.0, 68.5), axes parallel to the enclosure x/y, y up; the board top (KiCad F side) faces the enclosure interior (+z), the bottom (KiCad B side) faces the hatch opening
